- Quick live phone interview (30–45m) from the airport (battery/spotty signal)
- Record a 15–20 minute screen-capture walkthrough of the coding exercise and submit it within 24–48 hours
- Reschedule the onsite for next week (I can be flexible)

Attaching my travel itinerary in case that helps. Again — sorry for the hassle. Let me know what you'd prefer and I will follow through.

Thanks,
Diego

Thanks for the update, Diego — I appreciate you flagging this and I'm sorry you're dealing with customs.

Panel, quick context: Diego is scheduled for an onsite on Fri 7/13 at 11:00am PT (onsite panel: Marissa, Jonas, Stephanie). Candidate is currently delayed at SFO customs and expects to be cleared but not in time for the onsite. Diego suggests either a short live call or a short recorded walkthrough of the exercise.

Marissa/Stephanie/Jonas — would you accept a recorded 15–20m screen walkthrough plus a 20–30m live Q&A (phone) if the recording looks like it covers the exercise? If yes, we will:
- Ask Diego to submit a 15–20m screen-capture video (no special format; MP4 OK) within 48 hours.
- Schedule a 20–30m live follow-up Q&A with the panel (we can do short blocks across the day).
- Offer the candidate our standard interview stipend (we typically pay $125 for travel/effort) since this is extra work.

If the team prefers not to evaluate asynchronously, we will reschedule the onsite for next week.

I've attached the take-home/spec doc we usually send so the candidate knows the exact prompt if he chooses the recording. Diego — can you confirm which option you prefer ASAP? If you choose the recorded walkthrough, please include a rough ETA for submission.

Thanks — Kim
